_comment: Every item exists to enable something specific. value = base price in glims.

glowbeet_seed.name: Glowbeet Seed
glowbeet_seed.desc: Wants warmth, water and light. In return it glows.

moss_spore.name: Cave Moss Spores
moss_spore.desc: Grows almost anywhere damp and cool. Breathes in stale air.

fern_spore.name: Sulfur Fern Spores
fern_spore.desc: A fern that thrives where nothing else will: in sour air. It eats the sour.

emberroot_seed.name: Emberroot Cutting
emberroot_seed.desc: Needs real heat to take. Plant it near something hot.

bellcap_spore.name: Bellcap Spores
bellcap_spore.desc: Fruits only in the dark. Light ruins it.

glowbeet.name: Glowbeet
glowbeet.desc: Sweet, faintly luminous. Food, and a fair fuel for a burner.

moss_fiber.name: Moss Fiber
moss_fiber.desc: Dried cave moss. Filters, insulation, wire wrapping.

sulfur.name: Sulfur
sulfur.desc: Yellow crystals a fern left behind after eating the air.

ember_resin.name: Ember Resin
ember_resin.desc: Sticky, slow-burning. Seals pipes. Burns hotter than beets.

bellcap.name: Bellcap
bellcap.desc: A pale mushroom that rings faintly when tapped. A delicacy.

blackstone.name: Blackstone
blackstone.desc: Dense basalt. Holds its shape and its heat.

brass_scrap.name: Brass Scrap
brass_scrap.desc: Salvage from the old works. Pipe, wire, fittings — everything.

glowglass.name: Glowglass
glowglass.desc: Crystal that holds a little light. Lenses, lamps, turbine vanes.

thermal_ore.name: Thermal Ore
thermal_ore.desc: Warm to the touch, always. Stores heat; stores charge.

pipe_section.name: Pipe Section
pipe_section.desc: Lay one per cell of pipe. Also patches a burst segment.

wire_coil.name: Wire Coil
wire_coil.desc: Lay one per cell of wire.

filter_pad.name: Filter Pad
filter_pad.desc: Moss and sulfur pressed together. A scrubber eats one every half day.

seal_gum.name: Seal Gum
seal_gum.desc: Resin worked soft. Seals a cracked pipe without replacing it.

fertiliser.name: Fertiliser
fertiliser.desc: Rich and unpleasant. A plot dressed with it grows faster for a while.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.desc: What a scrubber leaves behind. Compost it, or it becomes someone's problem.

moss_tea.name: Moss Tea
moss_tea.desc: Bitter, green, steadying. Breath lasts longer in bad air.

glowbeet_stew.name: Glowbeet Stew
glowbeet_stew.desc: Mags' recipe, near enough. Warms you through.

respirator.name: Respirator
respirator.desc: Crew pattern. Breathe sour air for much longer.

lamp_lens.name: Glowglass Lens
lamp_lens.desc: Fits your headlamp. The dark gets further away.

governor_coil.name: Governor Coil
governor_coil.desc: A heavy brass coil stamped STN-7 / PRIMARY. It hums when you hold it near iron.

wren_token.name: Crew Tag
wren_token.desc: A dented brass tag: W. ASKEW — TRUNK CREW. Warm, like it was held recently.
